scope: E5 feasibility audit only; read-only local and authoritative-source inspection

classification_rubric.READY: locally runnable with pinned artifacts and no setup
classification_rubric.EASY_SETUP: small unprivileged isolated environment only; no source adaptation or service
classification_rubric.MODERATE_SETUP: reproducible source/artifacts but isolated dependencies and adapter/preprocessing required
classification_rubric.HARD_SETUP: new DBMS/system service, privileged packages, or substantial port required
classification_rubric.BLOCKED: indispensable implementation, artifact, license permission, platform, or authority unavailable

froid_sql_server.source_available: Product implementation proprietary; public research description and official feature documentation available
froid_sql_server.required_runtime: SQL Server 2019+ with compatibility level 150; SQL Server 2022 CU10+ for supported Ubuntu 22.04 deployment
froid_sql_server.install_build: Microsoft repository, privileged mssql-server and mssql-tools installation, edition/password configuration, system service
froid_sql_server.dataset_workload: Port controlled tables and inlineable UDF subset to T-SQL; compare inlining enabled/disabled and validate plan XML
froid_sql_server.license: Developer edition free for non-production development/test; proprietary engine
froid_sql_server.compatibility_notes: IF/ELSE and straight-line constructs supported; documented inlineable list excludes procedural WHILE loops, so exact loop experiments cannot be presumed inlineable
froid_sql_server.visible_representation: supported imperative T-SQL transformed into relational scalar expressions
froid_sql_server.decision_consumer: SQL Server relational cost optimizer and plan generator

qfusor.local_notes: Survey integration directory empty; paper present elsewhere, optimizer implementation absent
qfusor.source_available: Public repository exposes experimental queries/UDFs and GPL-3.0 license, not optimizer implementation
qfusor.required_runtime: DBMS with plan generation, C UDF registration, Python/PyPy, CFFI/compiler, and engine adapter
qfusor.install_build: Not determinable reproducibly without unreleased implementation/build instructions
qfusor.license: GPL-3.0 for released repository contents; implementation licensing unavailable because implementation is absent
qfusor.visible_representation: DBMS plan plus UDF/relational data dependencies and fusible operator groups
qfusor.visibility_stage: post-native-plan fusion optimizer, followed by code generation and query/plan rewrite
qfusor.decision_consumer: QFusor rule- and cost-based fusion optimizer
qfusor.blocking_condition: essential optimizer/plugin source and pinned build procedure not released

graceful.required_runtime: Python environment pinned around DuckDB 0.10.1, PyTorch 1.13.1 CUDA 11.6, DGL 0.9.1 CUDA 11.6, NumPy 1.23.5, Graphviz, and supporting ML/data packages
graceful.install_build: Isolated Conda environment; CPU-only feasibility variant recommended because NVIDIA driver is unavailable; controlled adapter required
graceful.dataset_workload: Canonical OSF query traces, UDF benchmark, DuckDB databases, feature statistics, and pretrained checkpoints; local candidate copies require provenance/hash validation
graceful.license: Apache-2.0 source; paper CC BY 4.0; artifact provenance must be checked
graceful.visible_representation: Python UDF CFG transformed to annotated acyclic single-statement graph with INV/COMP/BRANCH/LOOP/LOOP_END/RET nodes, joined to query-plan graph
graceful.visibility_stage: offline graph extraction/annotation and learned-model inference
graceful.decision_consumer: Graceful runtime estimator and external pull-up/push-down advisor; not the native DBMS optimizer by default

recommendation.reason: Only candidate with public implementation, extensive local artifacts, strong semantic alignment with controlled Python loop/branch/predicate workloads, and no prerequisite new DBMS
recommendation.next_probe: Pinned CPU-only inference smoke on one canonical local artifact, then an adapter-only representation check for copied E1-E4 UDFs and one preregistered E2 placement decision

security_note: A credential-bearing remote URL exists in the derivative Graceful checkout. Its value is intentionally redacted; do not copy that remote configuration and rotate the credential separately.
